(function(){var T=__dbg.THREE,ps=__dbg.cloud.userData.puffs,cam=__dbg.camera,c=window.__cc;var n=new T.Vector3(),w=new T.Vector3(),t=new T.Vector3(),q=new T.Vector3();window.__probe=function(azD,elD,r){var a=azD*Math.PI/180,e=elD*Math.PI/180;cam.position.set(c.x+r*Math.cos(e)*Math.sin(a),c.y+r*Math.sin(e),c.z+r*Math.cos(e)*Math.cos(a));cam.up.set(0,1,0);cam.lookAt(c);cam.updateMatrixWorld(true);var back=0,backOn=0;for(var i=0;i<ps.length;i++){var p=ps[i];p.plate.getWorldDirection(n);p.plate.getWorldPosition(w);t.copy(cam.position).sub(w);if(n.dot(t)<0){back++;q.copy(w).project(cam);if(Math.abs(q.x)<1&&Math.abs(q.y)<1&&q.z<1)backOn++;}}return {back:back,backOn:backOn};};return 'probe ready';})()

(function(){var best=[];for(var az=0;az<360;az+=10){for(var ei=0;ei<9;ei++){var el=[-60,-40,-20,-5,10,30,60,75,85][ei];for(var ri=0;ri<5;ri++){var r=[5,8,12,20,34][ri];var q=window.__probe(az,el,r);if(q.backOn>0)best.push({az:az,el:el,r:r,back:q.back,on:q.backOn});}}}best.sort(function(a,b){return b.on-a.on;});return JSON.stringify({total:best.length,top:best.slice(0,10)});})()
